review:
Jaws of Justice is set in space, and its stars are Laser Sharks. When one activates, it fires straight up or diagonally to either side, turning every paying symbol in its path into a wild, and becomes a wild itself at the end of the spin.

Force Fields on three edges of the grid bounce the lasers back, so one beam can zig-zag across the board, and hitting an existing wild adds a multiplier to it. The Killer Cosmos and Chompocalypse bonuses raise shark activity, and the cap is 10,000x. The rebounds make each laser fun to watch.
